scope: FX research and simulated trades only; no broker orders

roles.job: Universe scan, source recovery and decision summary
Balanced outcome, lifecycle and publication audit

cadence_note: Five distinct hourly duties. Not five duplicate scans, a 12-minute polling service, real-time execution, or proof of completed runs.
notification_policy: Only market_scan retains a concise daytime summary; other roles persist quietly. Quiet hours 23:00-07:00 Europe/London.
recovery_ownership: market_scan may request one current-main full collection when stale; position_monitor may request one bounded existing fast recovery for open/prospectively pending paper plans only. Other roles do not start duplicate scans. Coalesce an in-progress request. No new dispatcher or periodic commit claimed independent.
authority: Current validation_protocol.json and registered rule hashes; no rule changes, promotion, risk increases, fabricated entries/exits or reset of existing cohorts. OANDA research prices are not Pepperstone fills.
